Data extraction from metric graphs for 'rSPDE' models

Source: R/inla_rspde.R
graph_data_rspde.Rd

Extracts data from metric graphs to be used by 'INLA' and 'inlabru'.

Usage

graph_data_rspde(
  graph_rspde,
  name = "field",
  repl = NULL,
  repl_col = NULL,
  group = NULL,
  group_col = NULL,
  only_pred = FALSE,
  loc = NULL,
  bru = FALSE,
  tibble = FALSE,
  drop_na = FALSE,
  drop_all_na = TRUE
)

Arguments
